name: Kodama of the West Tree
oracle_text:
Reach
Modified creatures you control have trample. (Equipment, Auras you control, and counters are modifications.)
Whenever a modified creature you control deals combat damage to a player, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a modified creature you control deals combat damage to a player, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

needs.what: the `modified` key (true: has a counter, is equipped, or is enchanted by an Aura its controller controls) accepted in a trigger `filter`, so a `deals_combat_damage_to_player` trigger with filter {controller: you, types: [Creature], modified: true} fires only for a creature that is modified when it deals the damage
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `modified` is in selector_keys and static_affects_filter_keys (so the trample line is expressible), but not in trigger_filter_keys / engine.triggers.TRIGGER_FILTER_KEYS, which the loader enforces. An any_of of has_counters and enchanted_by in the trigger filter misses the equipped limb (`equipped` is not a trigger filter key either; `attached` means attached to the ability's source). Moving the test into the trigger's `condition` as an `exists` over the subject binding makes it an intervening-if that is rechecked on resolution, so a creature that loses its counter or Equipment before resolution would wrongly find no land -- a different card.
